known.via: English Wikipedia "South West France wine" (redirects to "South West France (wine region)")

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

notes: Madiran, from Tannat, is typically very concentrated and high in tannin.
Jurançon is a sweet white from Gros and Petit Manseng, and Jurançon Sec is its dry version.

blurb.text: A wine region inland and south of Bordeaux. It holds Jurançon, Madiran, Bergerac and Gaillac.
